topics.title: Record Sales and Obsessive Fantasies
topics.summary: During the broadcast, two individuals discuss declining record sales for Pro Jam while engaging in bizarre conversations including claims about obsessive rituals, anxieties surrounding mental illness, and fabricated encounters involving impersonators attempting to lure women into compromising situations. The conversation drifts into discussions of celebrity obsessions and unsettling personal experiences.

topics.title: Kabbalah, Celebrity Critique & Racial Guessing
topics.summary: The program features a meandering discussion about Jewish mysticism (Kabbalah), with participants speculating on its potential for witchcraft and making broad assessments of celebrity behavior. The conversation quickly shifts to guessing the ethnicities of actors based on limited information, culminating in an ill-defined game attempting to identify a homosexual man.

topics.title: Gay K-Rock Intern & Traffic Reporter Mishap
topics.summary: A gay k-rock intern, Gary, discusses his experiences and a traffic reporter at WND shares an awkward story about being questioned by Fred. A crude cruise song parody of "We Are The World" is played with Robin Quiverts, followed by callers discussing fantasies and one sharing details about her lesbian experience.

topics.title: Strip Club Confessions and Golden Globes Recap
topics.summary: During the radio segment, a caller discusses purchasing lingerie from a stripper while discussing financial aspirations alongside listeners sharing experiences at bars and critiques of Burt Reynolds’s Golden Globe performance including his new toupee. The host then recaps the awards show, focusing on Reynolds' supporting actor win for ‘Boogie Nights’ and criticisms leveled against him by foreign press.

topics.title: Golden Globes - Unscripted Reactions
topics.summary: During a Golden Globe broadcast, commentators observe chaotic reactions from attendees including excessive crying and racially charged commentary regarding Ving Rhames’ performance and Jack Lemon's appearance; Kim Bassinger is described as ‘waggy,’ while concerns are raised about Stanislavski’s speech. The event features multiple instances of emotional displays and awkward interactions among the presenters culminating in a bizarre exchange involving Alec Baldwin and his wife.

topics.title: Awards Show Host’s Rambling Remarks & Seltzer
topics.summary: "An awards show host launches into an incoherent monologue, making inappropriate comments about cast members like Peter Fonda and Calista Flockhart while expressing frustration with award categories. He engages in tangential discussions regarding David Kelly's writing contributions and the perceived lack of attention to Michael J Fox’s achievement before concluding with a performance of ‘The Rolling Stone’ song ‘Running For The Seltzer.’"
